title: 2.1: Move CI (and engines) to Node 24 LTS (W3)
body:
<!-- gitissue:normalized v1 -->

## Type

improvement (high confidence)

## Description

Replace `node-version: '20'` in all four jobs. Target Active LTS 24 (EOL 2028-04-30). If a native module blocks 24, pin 22 Maintenance LTS with a written rationale.
